sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • Warsh’s FOMC Debut: Decision at 14:00 ET, press conference at 14:30 ET. The market is pricing in roughly a 97% probability of a fourth consecutive hold at 3.50%-3.75%. The focus is whether the dot plot removes the single rate-cut forecast from March, whether the wording shifts from dovish-leaning to neutral, and whether as many as 3 members may vote in favor of a rate hike. 28 minutes after the open, SPY was at $750.04 (-0.07%), nearly flat versus yesterday’s close and chopping sideways below the 751 level; QQQ +0.17%, DIA +0.32%, IWM +0.56% — small caps and the Dow leading, mega-cap tech lagging, a typical light-positioning wait-and-see setup before the decision.
  • May Retail Sales Blowout: MoM +0.9% (expected +0.4%), excluding gas stations +0.7%, online +1.5%. Consumer resilience, combined with last week’s CPI at 4.2% YoY (a three-year high), reinforces the “no room for rate cuts, possibly even stealth hawkish” narrative.
  • SPCX Nears Its First Red Day: Current price $196.74 (-2.55%), having plunged intraday from $213.73 to below $198, breaking the 200 round-number level after an opening pop-and-drop. The “first red day after listing” that the community has been repeatedly betting on over the past several days is very likely materializing today, washing out both FOMO buyers and shorts.
  • US-Iran MOU Whipsaw: Trump said at the G7 that the document was “just a memorandum of understanding; if we’re not satisfied, we’ll go back and drop bombs,” denied the $300 billion investment fund, and said there would be no immediate sanctions relief. Signing was moved to Friday (market closed). The peace narrative is fading; oil prices are rebounding, while energy stocks are actually weakening.
  • Mega-Cap Tech/SaaS Continues to Bleed: META -2.44%, GOOG -1.87%, AMZN -1.63%, MSFT -1.07% (approaching a 52-week low, YTD about -20%), NFLX -1.14%. Semiconductors, however, are seeing a bifurcated rebound: AVGO +3.72% (JPM bullish on TPU), WDC +3.43%, MRVL +1.96%, MU slightly up, SNDK turning lower.
  • Market Holiday Reminder: Thursday 6/18 is triple witching (OPEX), Friday 6/19 is Juneteenth market closure; only two trading days remain this week.

社区氛围：整体混乱且疲惫，三种情绪交织在一起：“辞职前的决定”、对大型科技公司（尤其是 MSFT）的集体发泄，以及对 SPCX 的爱恨交织。 Warsh 讲话后，大多数人选择保留现金或进行小额 0DTE 赌注。

恐惧/贪婪：中立到谨慎。社区自评情绪为“47%”，既不恐慌也不欣喜；主要的情绪是磨削横向动作带来的刺激。

情绪与现实：社区压倒性地认为“沃什是一个傀儡，必须鸽派，必须拉动”，但理性阵营警告说，在通货膨胀加剧和隐秘鹰派委员会的情况下，他必须采取独立行动，否则就会失去信誉。实际情况与预期有所不同——大型科技股正在下跌，SPCX 呈红色，指数主要受到小型股的支撑，这与“保证上涨”的预期相反。
